title: Climbing letters
prompt:
Find a six-letter word that means "nearly". Its letters are in alphabetical order from the first to the last: each letter is later in the alphabet than the one before it.

What is the word?
hints: Which different words could replace "nearly" in a sentence?
Which of those candidates have six letters?
For each six-letter candidate, check whether every letter comes later in the alphabet than the one before it. Where does a candidate first fail?
solution:
**Almost.**

Six-letter words for "nearly" include ALMOST and MOSTLY. Checking the alphabet order: A-L-M-O-S-T climbs all the way. MOSTLY fails because after T comes L, which is earlier in the alphabet.

Testing each candidate against the letter pattern removes all but one.
